text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at six thirty and start my day with a glass of water and a light breakfast. I begin work at nine and stay focused until five, with a short break for lunch. After work, I go to the gym or take a long walk in the park. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a film with my family. I try to go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent helps me feel healthy, calm, and ready for the next day.
